about: Sherri M. Anderson represents clients in divorce cases which involve complex financial or international jurisdictional issues. She has been consistently recognized as one of the Top 100 Superlawyers and Top 50 Women Superlawyers in Washington. In 2023 and 2024, Sherri was recognized as one of the "Top 10" Superlawyers in Washington. She began her career at Preston Gates & Ellis in 1991 and became a partner of the firm. In 2002, Sherri opened her own law office. She is a proud graduate of the University of Washington School of Law ('91). Sherri is one of 100 Diplomates of the American College of Family Trial Lawyers and a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and the International Academy of Family Lawyers. In her free time, she serves on the boards of nonprofits focused on child welfare and education. She and her husband and their two sons are diehard fans of the Seattle Seahawks and avid fantasy football competitors.
